evals.prompt: Validate the mise tasks in this repo against kerpo conventions. Report only.
evals.expected_output: Agent inventories mise.toml and .mise/tasks, checks reserved names, one-liner threshold, usage/help, bats, shellcheck, secrets; prints errors/warns without rewriting files; may suggest refactor.

evals.prompt: Do we have shadowed mise task names like install?
evals.expected_output: Agent checks task names/aliases against the reserved denylist and reports collisions as errors with rename guidance (domain + subcommand).

evals.prompt: Audit whether our mise file tasks have bats and pass shellcheck.
evals.expected_output: Agent looks for tests/mise-tasks/*.bats mapped to file tasks, runs or cites shellcheck failures, and reports missing coverage as errors.
